## Design

### 2026-10-11 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-11 163445](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cpilvPVEqJF9hgfug8tp9qCvZOmgAIfF/709c77355e1fc867de07e3f8684018f39968b7b6ea66097258b0f87850494f13.png)

**2.25h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 163445](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cpilvPVEqJF9hgfug8tp9qCvZOmgAIfF/709c77355e1fc867de07e3f8684018f39968b7b6ea66097258b0f87850494f13.png)

Hello Everyone! :) I started my PCB project today. The goal is to create a PCB seal pet that I can take anywhere with me. I finished my schematic and started wiring the board. I am using the Starbie guide to get me started, but I might add some more features as I go along. Stay tuned for more updates!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/accd5257-badc-4bae-aa2a-2b63b17eae7c/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-11 – ![Screenshot 2026-10-11 195132](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cpilvPVEqJF9hgfug8tp9qCvZOmgAIfF/4558e8b2f78ae6167071038a1b4edd63d94af7e3f42b62bf916ed9f123548ace.png)

**1.98h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 195132](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cpilvPVEqJF9hgfug8tp9qCvZOmgAIfF/4558e8b2f78ae6167071038a1b4edd63d94af7e3f42b62bf916ed9f123548ace.png)

Hello again :)  Some problems arose as I continued to design the PCB. I had to change the shape from the seal design to a circle because it was making wiring difficult (but it works out b/c Chunk will resemble one of those chunky seal plushies :) ). I finished designing the PCB, and I'm about to start working on the Arduino code. Stay tuned for more updates!
